title: ‘Very risky choice’: Meloni warns US-Russia diesel deal could help fund Ukraine war
summary_full: Giorgia Meloni has expressed concerns about the US agreement with Russia regarding diesel supplies during her parliament address. She believes the deal could financially aid Russia's war efforts in Ukraine. Meloni urged the European Union to appoint a representative for negotiating peace talks with Russia. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy criticized the agreement, stating it could further support Moscow's military actions.
